Setup

# Download the complete project directory from Git, open it and then:
if (!requireNamespace("mvrem", quietly = TRUE)) {
  devtools::install()
}

library(mvrem)
d <- readr::read_tsv(
  system.file("data", "simulated_t_x1x2_y.tsv", package = "mvrem"),
  show_col_types = FALSE
)

Some simulated data

Enable to play with missing values in the data:

#d$x1[sample(seq_len(nrow(d)), nrow(d)/10)] <- NA
#d$x2[sample(seq_len(nrow(d)), nrow(d)/10)] <- NA

Overall structure of the data:

str(d)
## spc_tbl_ [3,050 × 5] (S3: spec_tbl_df/tbl_df/tbl/data.frame)
##  $ id: chr [1:3050] "S001" "S001" "S001" "S001" ...
##  $ t : num [1:3050] 0 0.5 1 1.5 2 2.5 3 3.5 4 4.5 ...
##  $ x1: num [1:3050] 1.19 1.18 1.18 1.14 1.11 ...
##  $ x2: num [1:3050] 0.207 0.164 0.201 0.185 0.192 ...
##  $ y : num [1:3050] 0.248 0.318 0.243 0.331 0.369 ...
##  - attr(*, "spec")=
##   .. cols(
##   ..   id = col_character(),
##   ..   t = col_double(),
##   ..   x1 = col_double(),
##   ..   x2 = col_double(),
##   ..   y = col_double()
##   .. )
##  - attr(*, "problems")=<externalptr>

Several random rows of the data:

d |> dplyr::sample_n(20L) |> showTab()

JSM model setup

This is how a user sets up a JSM model (without fitting it immediately):

jsmMdl <- jsm(
  formLong = list(
    x1 ~ 1 + t + (1 + t|id),
    x2 ~ 1 + t + (1 + t|id)
  ),
  dataLong = d,
  formOut = list(
    y ~ 1 + t + (1 + t|id)
  ),
  dataOut = d,
  familyOut = c(y = "beta"),
  fit = FALSE,
  userPars = list(
    #scaled(),
    #latent(y ~ (1 + t | id), ),
    "y_FROM_x1_id_t" = list(hyper = list(beta = list(initial = 2.2, param = c(0, 0.022)))),
    "y_FROM_x2_id_t" = list(hyper = list(beta = list(initial = 3.3, param = c(0, 0.033)))),
    "y_1_id" = list(hyper = list(theta1 = list(param = c(4, c(1, 0.0011), 0))))
  )
)

JSM model data plot

Based on the formulas and the data provided, the following plot visualizes the model data:

jsmMdl$plotData(addFamily = TRUE)

JSM model INLA families

It is possible to inspect the families and their parameters for the outcome variables:

jsmMdl$getFamilies()
##        y_y      x1_x1  x1_x1_0eq      x2_x2  x2_x2_0eq 
##     "beta" "gaussian" "gaussian" "gaussian" "gaussian"
jsmMdl$getControlFamilies() |> str()
## List of 5
##  $ y_y      : list()
##  $ x1_x1    : list()
##  $ x1_x1_0eq:List of 1
##   ..$ hyper:List of 1
##   .. ..$ prec:List of 2
##   .. .. ..$ initial: num 1
##   .. .. ..$ fixed  : logi TRUE
##  $ x2_x2    : list()
##  $ x2_x2_0eq:List of 1
##   ..$ hyper:List of 1
##   .. ..$ prec:List of 2
##   .. .. ..$ initial: num 1
##   .. .. ..$ fixed  : logi TRUE

JSM model INLA formula

It is possible to inspect the generated INLA formula for the user provided formulas (n specifies the number of rows of data to include in the comments):

jsmMdl$getFormulaText(addComments = TRUE, n = 4L) |>
  cat("\n")
MX ~ -1 +
   #
   # ----- y: y ~ 1 + t + (1 + t | id) -----
   #
   #        y_y y_1 y_t   y_1_id   y_t_id   y_FROM_x1_id_t   y_FROM_x2_id_t
   #  0.2475810   1 0.0 y|1|S001 y|t|S001   x1|TO|y|S001|0   x2|TO|y|S001|0
   #  0.3178289   1 0.5 y|1|S001 y|t|S001 x1|TO|y|S001|0.5 x2|TO|y|S001|0.5
   #  0.2429094   1 1.0 y|1|S001 y|t|S001   x1|TO|y|S001|1   x2|TO|y|S001|1
   #  0.3309120   1 1.5 y|1|S001 y|t|S001 x1|TO|y|S001|1.5 x2|TO|y|S001|1.5
   #
y_1 +
y_t +
f(y_1_id, model = "iid2d", values = LEVELS$y_1_t_id, n = length(LEVELS$y_1_t_id), hyper = list(theta1 = list(prior = "wishart2d", param = c(4, 1, 0.0011, 0)))) +
f(y_t_id, y_t, copy = "y_1_id") +
f(y_FROM_x1_id_t, copy = "x1_TO_y_id_t", hyper = list(beta = list(fixed = FALSE, prior = "normal", initial = 2.2, param = c(0, 0.022)))) +
f(y_FROM_x2_id_t, copy = "x2_TO_y_id_t", hyper = list(beta = list(fixed = FALSE, prior = "normal", initial = 3.3, param = c(0, 0.033)))) +
   #
   # ----- x1: x1 ~ 1 + t + (1 + t | id) -----
   #
   #     x1_x1 x1_x1_0eq x1_1 x1_t   x1_1_id   x1_t_id x1_WEIGHT     x1_TO_y_id_t
   #  1.189799        NA    1  0.0 x1|1|S001 x1|t|S001        NA             <NA>
   #  1.177683        NA    1  0.5 x1|1|S001 x1|t|S001        NA             <NA>
   #  1.182500        NA    1  1.0 x1|1|S001 x1|t|S001        NA             <NA>
   #  1.135314        NA    1  1.5 x1|1|S001 x1|t|S001        NA             <NA>
   #        NA         0    1  0.0 x1|1|S001 x1|t|S001        -1   x1|TO|y|S001|0
   #        NA         0    1  0.5 x1|1|S001 x1|t|S001        -1 x1|TO|y|S001|0.5
   #        NA         0    1  1.0 x1|1|S001 x1|t|S001        -1   x1|TO|y|S001|1
   #        NA         0    1  1.5 x1|1|S001 x1|t|S001        -1 x1|TO|y|S001|1.5
   #
x1_1 +
x1_t +
f(x1_1_id, model = "iid2d", values = LEVELS$x1_1_t_id, n = length(LEVELS$x1_1_t_id), hyper = list(theta1 = list(prior = "wishart2d", param = c(3, 1, 0.004, 0)))) +
f(x1_t_id, x1_t, copy = "x1_1_id") +
f(x1_TO_y_id_t, x1_WEIGHT, model = "iid", values = LEVELS$x1_TO_y_id_t, hyper = list()) +
   #
   # ----- x2: x2 ~ 1 + t + (1 + t | id) -----
   #
   #      x2_x2 x2_x2_0eq x2_1 x2_t   x2_1_id   x2_t_id x2_WEIGHT     x2_TO_y_id_t
   #  0.2066903        NA    1  0.0 x2|1|S001 x2|t|S001        NA             <NA>
   #  0.1638209        NA    1  0.5 x2|1|S001 x2|t|S001        NA             <NA>
   #  0.2012768        NA    1  1.0 x2|1|S001 x2|t|S001        NA             <NA>
   #  0.1851584        NA    1  1.5 x2|1|S001 x2|t|S001        NA             <NA>
   #         NA         0    1  0.0 x2|1|S001 x2|t|S001        -1   x2|TO|y|S001|0
   #         NA         0    1  0.5 x2|1|S001 x2|t|S001        -1 x2|TO|y|S001|0.5
   #         NA         0    1  1.0 x2|1|S001 x2|t|S001        -1   x2|TO|y|S001|1
   #         NA         0    1  1.5 x2|1|S001 x2|t|S001        -1 x2|TO|y|S001|1.5
   #
x2_1 +
x2_t +
f(x2_1_id, model = "iid2d", values = LEVELS$x2_1_t_id, n = length(LEVELS$x2_1_t_id), hyper = list(theta1 = list(prior = "wishart2d", param = c(3, 1, 0.004, 0)))) +
f(x2_t_id, x2_t, copy = "x2_1_id") +
f(x2_TO_y_id_t, x2_WEIGHT, model = "iid", values = LEVELS$x2_TO_y_id_t, hyper = list())

JSM model INLA data objects

It is possible to inspect the generated INLA model data.

The INLA left hand side data frame (n limits the number of rows shown per block):

jsmMdl$getFrs(colGrps = c("L", "L0"), n = 4L) |>
  dplyr::bind_cols() |>
  showTab()

The INLA right hand side data frame:

jsmMdl$getFrs(colGrps = c("R", "R0"), n = 4L) |>
  dplyr::bind_cols() |>
  showTab()

Linking of the model longitudinal and outcome components is facilitated by the levels of factor constructed for various variables:

jsmMdl$getLevels() |> str()
## List of 3
##  $ y :List of 3
##   ..$ y_1_t_id    : chr [1:100] "y|1|S001" "y|1|S002" "y|1|S003" "y|1|S004" ...
##   ..$ x1_TO_y_id_t: chr [1:3050] "x1|TO|y|S001|0" "x1|TO|y|S001|0.5" "x1|TO|y|S001|1" "x1|TO|y|S001|1.5" ...
##   ..$ x2_TO_y_id_t: chr [1:3050] "x2|TO|y|S001|0" "x2|TO|y|S001|0.5" "x2|TO|y|S001|1" "x2|TO|y|S001|1.5" ...
##  $ x1:List of 2
##   ..$ x1_1_t_id   : chr [1:100] "x1|1|S001" "x1|1|S002" "x1|1|S003" "x1|1|S004" ...
##   ..$ x1_TO_y_id_t: chr [1:3050] "x1|TO|y|S001|0" "x1|TO|y|S001|0.5" "x1|TO|y|S001|1" "x1|TO|y|S001|1.5" ...
##  $ x2:List of 2
##   ..$ x2_1_t_id   : chr [1:100] "x2|1|S001" "x2|1|S002" "x2|1|S003" "x2|1|S004" ...
##   ..$ x2_TO_y_id_t: chr [1:3050] "x2|TO|y|S001|0" "x2|TO|y|S001|0.5" "x2|TO|y|S001|1" "x2|TO|y|S001|1.5" ...

Calling INLA

Call to INLA for fitting the JSM model:

inlaRes <- tryCatch(
  jsmMdl$callInla(),
  error = function(e) {
    message("Error occurred while calling INLA: ", e$message)
    NULL
  }
)
summary(inlaRes)
